source.title: This Could Get Expensive...
source.description:
In order to create this alloy, we'll need a lot of materials to experiment with. I've prepared a list and, well, I told you it might get expensive.

<Omarion hands you a list that's nearly as long as your forearm.>
source.objective: Bring Master Craftsman Omarion 20 Arcanite Bars, 20 Obsidian-Infused Thorium Bars, 120 Truesilver Bars, 10 Huge Emeralds, and 20 Righteous Orbs.
source.progress: Listen, creating metallurgic miracles doesn't just happen by magic. You need time, patience, and someone with deep pockets.
source.completion: Thinking about the cost of all of this makes my eyes water a bit. Oh well, nothing ventured, nothing gained.
